results.note: Drops the emptiness guard before a hunk, so an empty clean segment is emitted when a hunk starts the file or follows another hunk.
Never resets the clean accumulator, so context from before a hunk leaks into and duplicates in every later clean segment.
Re-reads the >>>>>>> terminator line as clean text, putting a conflict marker back into the output.
Drops the kind check on the following segment, so after-context is taken from a hunk segment (whose .lines is empty) instead of clean text.
Exact match instead of prefix match: a real '<<<<<<< ours' header is treated as clean text and no hunk is ever found.
Swaps the ours/theirs id prefixes, so selecting O1 yields the theirs line and vice versa.
One-line-either-side counts as a paragraph hunk, misclassifying a 1-vs-many conflict the sub-line report cannot describe.
split keeps a trailing empty element for a newline-terminated file, appending a spurious blank line on reassembly.
Compares the ours line against itself, so the report always shows zero differences and empty phrase lists.
Tokenising on spaces only: tabs/newlines glue words together and runs of spaces yield empty tokens, skewing phrases and the ratio.
